name: Ameerex Corporation
summary: Ameerex Corporation operates as an investment and resource development company. Its portfolio covers critical minerals, precious metals, and energy assets. The company’s interests include lithium projects in South America; the Corcoran Canyon silver-gold project in North America; the Balfour copper-cobalt project in Australia; and oil and gas assets in North America. The company was formerly known as Hiru Corporation and changed its name to Ameerex Corporation in September 2025. Ameerex Corporation is based in Atlanta, Georgia.
